This specimen contains no completed personal details. The fields for
the author, recipient, copied recipients and checking officer are
empty. A printed field caption must not be treated as the name of
the person who will later complete the form.

Where a professional qualification follows a signatory's name, the
completed record must preserve the distinction between the name and
the qualification. The abbreviations KC, QC and LLB in this guidance
are examples of professional letters only and identify no individual.

The expression “for and on behalf of” describes the capacity in which
a signature may be supplied. It does not itself name a private body
or authorise someone to add a signature to a document that has not
been approved by the person represented.

The illustrative copying allowance is GBP 25. The dates on the form
describe production and review steps, not dates of birth. Section 4.2,
article 19 and schedule 3 are legal references, not claim numbers.

Check the page count and the legibility of the margins before filing.
Do not fill blank contact fields with sample telephone, email or
account values. An incomplete specimen should remain visibly incomplete.
